column1: # Held-out phrasings for the completion-claim guard (`crates/voice-domain/tests/held_out.rs`).
# Written separately from the classifier and never used to tune it: when a line here is
# missed, the miss is reported, and the classifier is not changed to catch it.
# Columns: truth <TAB> group <TAB> heard request <TAB> reply, its sentences split by " / " as
# the app's sentence stream would send them.
#   truth  — claim: the reply says an action happened; ok: it does not.
#   group  — review-b1, review-b2, review-split: phrasings a third review published (it did not
#            publish all of its sentences); review-final: requests from a final check (the replies
#            to its four statement-requests were not published and are written here); own: written
#            for this file; unprompted: a claim in reply to an informational question, which the
#            sentence classifier alone cannot be expected to catch.
# Pinned: every claim ends with the turn-level disclosure (an unprompted one can only be caught
# by the uninvited-assertion screen; the disclosure is still owed). Everything else is reported
# as rates in D-027, not pinned.
